title: THE BELT ANSWERS IN THE HUD VOICE
why: From the review of the four-gun belt, build 4, and his order of 2026-10-09 that every line the player reads sounds like a shooter HUD. Dragging a gun on the Undercroft floor belt still answered in explaining sentences beside the new ALL CAPS toast: that gun is your only gun, X traded places with Y, X to slot 1, and how to take a gun out of your hands. They are short ALL CAPS callouts now (ONLY ONE GUN, RIFLE ON KEY 2 then SWAPPED WITH SMG, UNEQUIP IN ARMOURY) and say key, not slot, like the rest of the belt. A click on an empty key of the Stash screen belt now says TACTICAL BELT then HOVER AN ITEM + PRESS 1-9, and the pad way on a controller.
now: The belt answers on the Undercroft floor and the Stash screen are short ALL CAPS callouts.
